sections.heading: 1. Modes of Reproduction
points: **Sexual reproduction** — involves **two parents** and the **fusion of male and female gametes**.
**Asexual reproduction** — involves a **single parent**; offspring identical to the parent.

sections.heading: 2. Sexual Reproduction
points: **Gametes:** male = **sperm** (from testes); female = **egg/ovum** (from ovary).
**Fertilisation** = fusion of sperm and egg → forms a **zygote** (the first cell of a new individual).

sub: **Internal fertilisation** — inside the female body (humans, cows, birds, dogs).
**External fertilisation** — outside the body, in water (fish, frogs).

sections.heading: 3. Development and Birth
points: The **zygote** divides repeatedly → **embryo** → **foetus** → a new individual.
**Viviparous animals** — give birth to **live young** (humans, cows).
**Oviparous animals** — **lay eggs** (birds, frogs, insects).
**Metamorphosis** — drastic change from larva to adult (e.g. **tadpole → frog; caterpillar → butterfly**).

sections.heading: 4. Asexual Reproduction and Cloning
points: **Budding** — a bud grows and detaches (e.g. **Hydra**).
**Binary fission** — the parent splits into two (e.g. **Amoeba**).
**Cloning** — producing an identical copy of an organism; the first cloned mammal was **Dolly the sheep (1996)**.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Sexual = two parents + gamete fusion; asexual = one parent, identical offspring.
Sperm (testes) + egg (ovary) → zygote (fertilisation).
Internal fertilisation (humans/birds) vs external (fish/frogs, in water).
Viviparous = live young; oviparous = lay eggs; metamorphosis = tadpole→frog, caterpillar→butterfly.
Budding = Hydra; binary fission = Amoeba; Dolly the sheep = first cloned mammal (1996).

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Fertilisation** forms the **zygote** (first cell); **internal** (in body) vs **external** (in water).
**Viviparous** = live birth; **oviparous** = egg-laying — don't swap.
**Budding = Hydra**; **binary fission = Amoeba**.
**Dolly the sheep** was the first **cloned mammal**.
